description: This file defines the `LogFragment` class, which is an Android Fragment that contains a custom `LogView` for displaying log data within a scrollable view. It sets up the view hierarchy programmatically, manages view properties such as padding and typeface, and handles text change events to auto-scroll to the bottom.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages a `LogView` inside a `ScrollView` to display logs and auto-scrolls when log content changes.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Programmatically creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, sets layout parameters, padding, typeface, and other properties, and returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Lifecycle method that inflates the view hierarchy, adds a TextWatcher to auto-scroll when logs update, and returns the constructed view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Accessor method to retrieve the internal LogView instance.
